column1: # #373 — the backbone runs the experiment review asked for, in the
# reviewer's own priority order. One row per backbone.
# id       an identifier; every artefact of the run carries it.
# gap      which review gap the row answers.
# launcher a file in this directory.
# arg      the launcher's first positional argument (its cell / arm).
# k        --train-rollout-depth.
# suffix   RUN_SUFFIX: appended to the run name after the _cf373k<K> part,
#          so a control cannot collide with the cell it controls for.
#          `-` means empty.
# seed     backbone seed. 20260520 is the protocol's; anything else is a
#          second training of the same recipe.
# gap_args extra trainer flags, appended after EXTRA_ARGS so they override a
#          per-cell `case` arm. `-` means none.
# steps    the stop to train to.
# id
G3_A3_k0_aw4
